Cors._comment: Origins allowed to call this API from a browser. The React dev server (Vite) defaults to 5173; add the deployed SPA origin here for production.

JwtSettings._comment: CHANGE Key BEFORE ANY REAL USE. It signs every token; anyone with it can mint valid logins. Minimum 32 characters.

NepaliCalendarSettings._comment_FiscalYearStartMonth: 4 = Shrawan. Nepali fiscal year runs Shrawan 1 to the last day of Ashadh.

DeviceConfiguration._comment: Seed data only. Devices are managed in the portal; the sync service reads the Devices table, not this list.

SyncConfiguration._comment_MinimumPunchIntervalSeconds: Two punches by the same person closer together than this count as one event.
SyncConfiguration._comment_ClockDriftToleranceSeconds: If a device clock is off by more than this, the server pushes its own time before reading.
SyncConfiguration._comment_OverlapWindowDays: Deliberately re-read this many days of history each round so nothing is missed after an outage.
SyncConfiguration._comment_UseFakeDeviceReader: true = generate sample punches so the system runs with no hardware.
SyncConfiguration._comment_DeviceProtocol: 'Fake' = simulated punches. 'Tcp' = pull from real ZKTeco devices over TCP port 4370 (no vendor DLL needed). When set, this overrides UseFakeDeviceReader.
SyncConfiguration._comment_DeviceCommPassword: The device Communication Password (Comm Key), if one is set on the terminal. 0 = none, which is the factory default.
